name: bharosa-docs
description: Bharosa public developer documentation, API references and coding examples. No account access or API execution.

interface.longDescription: Build Bharosa integrations using versioned public guides, API reference records and canonical SDK/cURL examples. Seven read-only tools search and retrieve a bundled snapshot with source paths and hashes. No Bharosa account or sign-in is needed. The connector does not read financial accounts, execute APIs or run example code. Synthetic/typecheck evidence does not certify live service availability.
defaultPrompt: Show the account retrieval API reference and TypeScript example.
Plan a portfolio integration using synthetic tests.

review.commerce_description: Public reference documentation only; no purchases, money transfers or account actions.

positive.expected_behavior: Returns bounded document metadata and pagination with snapshot provenance.

positive.prompt: Find and read Bharosa authentication documentation.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns public authentication guide text, not credentials or live account data.

positive.prompt: Find the account retrieval API reference and explain its request and response.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns retrieve_account specification with schema/example IDs; does not execute it.

positive.prompt: Show the canonical TypeScript account retrieval example.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns versioned example text and validation scope without execution.

positive.prompt: Plan a small Bharosa portfolio integration and explain how to test it with fixtures.
positive.tools_triggered: bharosa_docs_search, bharosa_docs_read, bharosa_api_search, bharosa_api_details, bharosa_examples_search, bharosa_examples_read
positive.expected_behavior: Grounds plan in retrieved references and proposes synthetic tests; reports unsupported capabilities.

negative.expected_behavior: Explains that tools only provide reference documentation, with no account access.
Does not perform a write or claim it happened.
Does not retrieve arbitrary filesystem content; only allowlisted reference IDs are available.
